name: Buildings (IGN BD TOPO, France)
description: Reads the building footprints, heights and floors around the point from the IGN BD TOPO through the Géoplateforme WFS (open licence Etalab 2.0; France only). It asks the service only when you press its button in Surface › More › Address to site; nothing is sent at start-up, no key is used, and the answer is kept 24 hours in this browser.
author: YannFR81
